ANGAMA SAFARI CAMP
This unique mobile camp, with just 4 tents, perfectly captures the light spirit of romance and adventure.
Our Tent can accommodate a maximum of 2 guests
PEAK SEASON SHOULDER SEASON STANDARD SEASON
1 Jul – 30 Sept, 5 Jan – 28 Feb, 1 Mar – 31 May,
& 23 Dec – 4 Jan 2028 1 – 30 Jun & 1 – 31 Oct & 1 Nov – 22 Dec
TENT SHARING $2,040 $1,400 $1,000
Per person per night Rack: $2,550 | Margin: $510 Rack: $1,750 | Margin: $350 Rack: $1,250 | Margin: $250
TENTED SINGLE $3,060 $2,100 $1,500
Per person per night Rack: $3,825 | Margin: $765 Rack: $2,625 | Margin: $525 Rack: $1,875 | Margin: $375
CHILDREN SHARING $1,535 $700 $500
Ages 0-17 per child night* Rack: $1,915 | Margin: $380 Rack: $875 | Margin: $175 Rack: $625 | Margin: $125
Children of all ages are welcome
*Any child staying in their own tent will pay adult rates in all seasons
RATE INCLUDES & EXCLUDES
All Angama Properties
• All meals, dining experiences, and beverages
(featuring a generous house offering of wines, spirits and Méthode Cap Classique)
• Laundry service & Wi-Fi
• All on-property guest experiences
• Emergency medical evacuation insurance
• Childminding (from 18h00 to 22h00)
• VAT and service charge
• Check in from 12h00 | Check out at 10h00
Includes
Angama Mara & Angama Safari Camp
• All guided safaris in the Mara Triangle
• Guided walking safaris on the Oloololo Escarpment
• Transfers to and from Kichwa Tembo Airstrip and Serena Airstrip (for Angama Safari Camp)
Angama Amboseli
• All guided safaris in Kimana Sanctuary & Amboseli National Park
• Guided walking safaris in Kimana Sanctuary
• Transfers to and from Kimana Airfield
All Angama Properties
• Angama Foundation contribution
• All additional guest experiences not otherwise listed
• Safari Shop purchases & in-suite spa treatments
• Air and road transfers from elsewhere
• Community visits
• Private safari vehicles
• Gratuities
• Reserve list of premium wines and champagnes
Excludes • Guaranteed late check out
Angama Mara & Angama Safari Camp
• Maasai Mara National Park Fees
Angama Amboseli
• Kimana Conservation Levy
• Amboseli National Park Fees
• Transfers to and from Amboseli Airstrip, $250 per vehicle per way
All prices are subject to change on short notice

per person sharing rate. Thereafter, all additional singles will be charged at single room rates

• Available at all Angama properties
Combinable with our ‘Combination Stays’ offer

• All standard inclusions and exclusions apply

— A hot-air balloon safari

— 1 hour on-property photoshoot

— Private vehicle*

— 1 hour on-property photoshoot at Angama Mara

• Combine 3 Angama properties = further 10%

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
FEES & LEVIES
Angama Foundation
$25 per guest per night (applicable to all guests)
Contribution
Jan – Jun: $100 per adult | $50 per child (Ages 9-17)
Jul – Dec: $200 per adult | $50 per child (Ages 9-17)
Maasai Mara Park Fees*
*Valid for 12 hours from 06h00 to 18h00. Rate may change without notice
Applicable when staying at Angama Mara & Angama Safari Camp
Angama Safari Camp Jul - Sept: $60 per adult | $40 per child (Ages 9-17)
Camping Fees
(Daily in addition to Maasai Mara Park Fees)
Jan – Dec: $80 per adult per night | $45 per child per night
Kimana Conservation Levy
Applicable when staying at Angama Amboseli
Amboseli National Park Jan – Dec: $90 per adult per day | $45 per child per day (Ages 6-17)
Park Fees (Children under 5 free of charge)
Park fees subject to change without notice
EXPERIENCES
Treatments on offer for singles or couples are as follows:
• Full-body Massage: 60min $125 per guest | 90min $150 per guest
In-Suite Spa Treatments
• Manicure: $50 per guest
• Pedicure: $50 per guest
• Weddings for up to 60 guests available at Angama Mara, and 20 guests at Angama Amboseli
Weddings, Maasai Blessings • For detailed information and pricing please see our Wedding Menus for both Angama Mara and
& Vow Renewals at Angama Angama Amboseli
Mara & Angama Amboseli • Maasai Blessings and Vow Renewals available from $100 per couple
• Bespoke wedding attire available, please browse our above mentioned Wedding Menus
• Guests staying at Angama Mara can enjoy a sleep out at Angama Safari Camp
Angama Safari Camp
• Strictly subject to availability and only bookable in camp
Sleep Out
• A $60 per guest Park Fee surcharge will be applied in Peak Season and settled in camp
• Recommended only for guests staying at Angama Amboseli for 4 nights or more
Tsavo West • Park Fees: $80 per adult per day | $40 per child per day (Ages 6-17)
(Children under 5 free of charge)
All experiences are subject to availability and prices are subject to change without notice
SAFARI & PHOTOGRAPHIC SERVICES
• A maximum of 6 guests will be accommodated on shared safari vehicles (7 guests on request)
• One private vehicle allocated per 3 Suites booked at Angama Mara and Angama Amboseli
Private Safari Vehicles • Rates for an additional vehicle:
— Shoulder & Peak Season: Full day: $800 | Half day: $400
— Standard Season: Full day: $400 | Half day: $200
• On-property photoshoots, safari photoshoots and on safari photography tutorials are available,
for detailed information and pricing, please enquire about our Photographic services
Photographic Services*
• Printing, camera and lens rentals are available on request
*Private safari vehicles are required for photoshoots and tutorials on safari, should one not already be allocated
